# Changelog

All notable changes to the Kartoza Timesheet App will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Added
- Initial repository structure with comprehensive GitHub workflows
- Quality assurance infrastructure with pre-commit hooks
- Professional documentation templates and guidelines
- Brand identity and design system
- Security scanning and vulnerability detection
- Automated CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions
- Development environment setup scripts
- Community guidelines and contribution process

### Development Infrastructure
- Pre-commit hooks for code quality (Go, Markdown, Shell, Python, Nix, HTML/CSS)
- GitHub Actions workflows for testing, building, and releasing
- Comprehensive issue and pull request templates
- Security policy and vulnerability reporting process
- Code of conduct based on Contributor Covenant
- MIT license for open source distribution

### Documentation
- Professional README with project overview and badges
- Contributing guidelines with development setup
- Support documentation with multiple channels
- Brand guidelines with design system
- Security policy with responsible disclosure

## Project Status

This project is in the initial setup phase. The core timesheet application features are planned for future releases.

### Quality & Security
